overview_description.description: Framewise Health provides AI-personalized, clinician-reviewed discharge education videos for patients. The company focuses on making recovery plans understandable by generating videos based on each patient’s diagnosis, medications, allergies, language, and discharge plan. Its platform supports more than 70 languages and tailors content to the patient’s preferred language and reading level. Framewise Health integrates with electronic health record systems via FHIR to pull necessary clinical data from existing workflows. Patients receive links to their recovery videos by SMS before leaving the hospital without needing to install an app or create a login. The service is intended for specialty groups, hospitals, and pharmaceutical organizations that need multilingual discharge education and HIPAA-compliant data handling.
